notes.title: Sequel & Patreon & Merch! Holy Cowabunga!
notes.content:
Greetings radical detectives- we've got a bunch of awesome news for you today!

1. A SEQUEL
2. Patreon!
3. Merch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/3675204bafcd2fe7cb9a4317d27ff3e75a6f5afc.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591150/Paranormal_Detective_Escape_from_the_90s/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/0f840f9ef275d7db3bc42bb3de643e0b729e631c.png[/img]
[/url]

1. We recently launched the Steam page for the SEQUEL (!) to this game!  You're looking for another missing kid, but this time you're investigating a haunted mall arcade with lots of retro 90's toys!  It's called "Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's".
We've been working on it since January, it'll launch in the fall, and we'll have a demo out that you can plan in the Steam Next Fest!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591150/Paranormal_Detective_Escape_from_the_90s/]Check it out and add it to your wishlist[/url] to stay updated with its developments!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/3675204bafcd2fe7cb9a4317d27ff3e75a6f5afc.png[/img]

[url=https://www.patreon.com/lunabeat][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/1d0f10de21190318c3aa1bbe813531ca710dcf7c.jpg[/img][/url]

2. We launched a Patreon!  There's a variety of tiers with some awesome rewards- follow along with our dev blog, get your name in our game, get a free VR game and even a T-shirt!  Lots of fun stuff to choose from- if you like our games and want to support us, check out [url=https://www.patreon.com/lunabeat]our Patreon page![/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/3675204bafcd2fe7cb9a4317d27ff3e75a6f5afc.png[/img]

[url=https://lunabeat.com/merch.php][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/581088272e7768e02ab7a1dc1510fdbcd3ed83f1.jpg[/img][/url]

3. Merch!  We created a merch store so you can load up on cool LunaBeat gear!  We've got the classic "Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 80's" VHS logo tape design for tees, hoodies & stickers, and we'll be adding more cool designs later!
[url=https://lunabeat.com/merch.php]Our merch store is here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/3675204bafcd2fe7cb9a4317d27ff3e75a6f5afc.png[/img]

Finally, for lots of neat screenshots, dev stuff and chatting, follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/lunabeatgames]@lunabeatgames[/url]!  We're having a great time over there, come join us!  :)

Thanks a bunch and we hope to see you on Patreon!

Your totally tubular devs,
Scott & Laura
LunaBeat

notes.title: Update Notes for 1/27/2021
notes.content: Did a quick patch to fix the bindings of the Knuckles controllers.  Should be able to grab with the right controller again and the joysticks should do the teleporting.  In game posters are updated to reflect this.  Thanks for playing our game! :)

notes.title: New QOL Update!
notes.content:
Greetings detectives!  We've released an update with a couple awesome features!

-Audio Remastering- the audio should be a little more evened out and easier to hear.

-Snap Turning- We added the ability to snap turn to either side, a frequent request!  (We love how it works, thanks for the suggestion!!)

-Debugging- There's always a couple bugs skittering around somewhere.  We squash what we can, when we can.  We're basically VR bug exterminators.

Did you know Grace Hopper found one of the earliest computer bugs in 1947 when an actual moth got into the computer and made it malfunction?!

Anyway!

Oh we also put a shelf under one of the puzzles so if you drop pieces you don't have to kneel down to pick them up off the floor
YW

That's about everything for this update!!  Thanks for reading, and if you like the game, please leave us a review- and let us know if you have any suggestions!!  The reviews help so much, and we love making the game better and better for our fans.

Thanks so much everyone!! Have a radical week!

notes.title: Update Out for Vive Index Controller
notes.content: Hey everyone!  We just released an update that resolves the issue mentioned in the comments.  It's a fix for a game-breaking bug in the last scene that occurs if you're using Vive Index Controllers.  We were able to locate the issue and patch it in this update, so Vive Index users are good to go to play the game!
